title: mini-weeding-robot wire protocol
description: One JSON message per line, both directions, over serial. The machine-checkable form of protocol/messages.md; that file is the authority on why, this one on shape. Every message object is closed (additionalProperties: false) so that a field nobody defined cannot ride along unnoticed.

seq.description: Monotonic per session. Correlates a streaming command with the last_seq the board echoes back, which is what link_age_ms is measured from.

id.description: Monotonic per session. Correlates a discrete command with its ack.

drive.description: Streaming command, 10 Hz, no ack, latest-wins. Carries seq and never id: Rule 4 (unacked -> ERROR) is scoped to discrete commands, and a drive in the pending table would turn one dropped frame into an error.

v_mm_s.description: Body velocity, mm/s. Positive is forwards.

omega_deg_s.description: Yaw rate, deg/s. Positive turns left (CCW, z up).

stop.description: Discrete. Controlled stop with the brake held; drive may follow without a reset. Different from drive(0, 0), which coasts.

emergency_stop.description: Discrete, highest priority. Cuts motor enable and latches; overrides every command outstanding in the same round.

reset.description: Discrete. Clears the emergency_stop and command_timeout latches. Refused with error code emergency_stop while the physical sense line is still active.

ack.description: Rover -> Controller. Discrete commands only; a drive is never acked.

rover_state.description: Telemetry at 20 Hz, tied to no command id. commanded is nested rather than flattened on purpose: there is no encoder, so a top-level v_mm_s would read like feedback. There is deliberately no measured field; adding one is M2, and additive.

commanded.description: An echo of the command in force, not a measurement.

estop.description: The sense line as read from the wire, not a software variable.

motors_enabled.description: false on command timeout, on estop, and before a reset.

uptime_ms.description: The board's own clock. A value that goes backwards means the MCU rebooted; it is not for measuring latency, which is what seq and last_seq are for.

error.description: Either direction. id is present only when the error answers a discrete command.

message.description: Human-readable, and expected to carry the numbers that identify the fault.

error_code.description: The seven codes of spec §8.5. Closed: a code nobody handles arrives at the controller as an unknown string.
